name: development-go
description: Go maintenance + review plugin. Review panel: /development-go:review runs 5 specialist agents (bugs, security, performance, code quality, tests) with Go-specific lenses. Maintenance dispatches findings from /development:maintenance to go-format-lint-fixer (golangci-lint v2), the static-analysis triage agents go-sonar-triage + go-code-scanning-triage + go-semgrep-triage (all three scanners ship — Go's support in each is deep), go-maintenance-planner, and go-ci-fixer. Blessed toolchain: Go modules, Taskfile, golangci-lint v2, go test -coverprofile, buf + grpc-gateway, ko. Coverage, bootstrap, vendor PRs, the approver, and the platform advisors land in later slices of #868.
